nodes.label: .`digits and punctuation wait for the lift`()
.`the repeat and scrub keys are excluded twice over`()
.`mode keys and multi-character output are excluded`()
.`a finger still on its own key is not a glide`()
.`a tap that strays just over its own edge is still a tap`()
.`a finger that travels a real distance off the key is a glide`()
.`the dead zone is a distance from the edge, not from either axis alone`()
.`a zero dead zone is exactly the bounds test it replaced`()
